The blacklist entries are lowercased, but `guest` is not. So `Spam@Blocked.com` gets past `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS`. The check against existing attendees also uses `===`, so an existing attendee can be added again just by changing letter case. The schema has no uniqueness rule and the uniqueness refine runs only on the client, so a direct API call with `[a@x.com, a@x.com]` makes `createMany` insert duplicate attendees.
